recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the FHIR-36666 nutrition-product/additive model across active ModelInfo surfaces while leaving broader FHIR-53504 NutritionOrder cleanup, including unrelated model/example mismatches, for separate Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-36666 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked how NutritionOrder should capture the amount of nutrition supplied by an order for any diet type.
